title: Circulating Biomarkers Repository in Adults Diagnosed With Primary and Metastatic Brain Tumors
official: Circulating Biomarkers Repository in Adults Diagnosed With Primary and Metastatic Brain Tumors
summary: The purpose of this protocol is to create a repository of blood samples from patients diagnosed with primary and metastatic brain tumors who are being seen in the Department of Radiation Oncology at Duke Cancer Center.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Have a confirmed diagnosis of primary or metastatic brain tumor (histology or imaging as appropriate)

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
